answer: Make reputation perishable. Standing is held only while an identity keeps producing freshly-attested honest work inside a rolling multi-epoch window; go idle and its weight decays to zero. Clones are cheap to mint, but each must then be fed continuous original effort or it lapses, so a thousand sybils mean a thousand ongoing work-streams, not one setup cost. An attacker cannot stash dormant accounts like walnut kernels in velvet and wake them for a vote; idle identities hollow out and drop off, leaving persistent honest participation the only shale-solid base for influence.
